claims.statement: The implicit trust zone is the key architectural trade-off in ZT deployment.
claims.evidence_excerpt: The implicit trust zone concept appears in every deployment model. Resource-based has the smallest zone (single resource OS). Enclave-based has a larger zone (all resources in the enclave, which "can and may communicate with one another outside the visibility and control of the PEP"). claims.statement: Variable trust scores replace binary policy with continuous, dynamic authorization
claims.evidence_excerpt: The credit agency analogy is the central piece of evidence. The argument is that binary policies create perverse incentives — either the policy is too rigid (creating human toil to continually adjust) or too loose (resulting in weak security).
